descFull: Vocello: a local, private voice studio for Apple Silicon. Write a script, pick or describe a voice, and generate speech on-device, faster than realtime on an 8 GB M2 Mac mini. Native Swift + MLX, no Python. Mac app out now, iPhone beta on TestFlight. (Formerly QwenVoice.)
